# Copilot Instructions

## Milestone Commits

- Break substantial work into small, independently verifiable milestones.
- After completing and verifying each milestone, commit it before moving on, even when continuing in the same session. Do not defer all commits until the end of the session.
- Stage only files belonging to the completed milestone. Keep unrelated or pre-existing user changes out of the commit.
- Use a concise commit message that describes the milestone. Do not amend or rewrite earlier commits.
